entities.name: Václav Malý
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Václav Malý is a Czech prelate of the Catholic Church who served as an auxiliary bishop of Prague from 1997 to 2025. He played a prominent role in the anti-communist dissent as well as the 1989 Velvet Revolution that toppled the communist regime in Czechoslovakia.

entities.summary: Václav Malý is a Czech prelate of the Catholic Church who served as an auxiliary bishop of Prague from 1997 to 2025. He played a prominent role in the anti-communist dissent as well as the 1989 Velvet Revolution that toppled the communist regime in Czechoslovakia.
